pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients; shapes are predominantly quadrilaterals and pentagons on the neck, becoming more irregular and fragmented on the mid-to-lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored pathways separating dark patches, forming trivalent and quadrivalent junction nodes. The pixel width is relatively uniform on the neck but narrows and becomes more complex on the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background, indicating short, dense hair.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large, contiguous area of hyper-pigmented and texturally disrupted skin on the upper dorsal ridge and shoulder, where the regular patch-corridor pattern is absent.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt transition from the standard reticulated pattern on the neck and lower flank to a solid, dark, thickened texture on the upper back.
